bootstrap.statistic: median of 21 paired absolute nanosecond differences
bootstrap.resampling: stratified by round; independently sample 7 complete pairs with replacement from each of 3 rounds and concatenate

diagnosticRules: No secondary metric substitutes for primary first draw gates.
Do not attribute gains to lock changes if only HTTP latency improves without local-phase or lock evidence.
Absent legacy lock counters are null, not zero.
Lock telemetry is pure numeric and read-only; no account identifier, URL, cookie, argument or secret export.
executionRules: Real existing signed-in installation, same UID and preserved preferences/Keystore.
After every install, complete an unscored launch and all automatic task checks; then force-stop, verify empty app cache and use a new PID for the scored launch.
Only --startup-state before first draw. Full UI/auth/network check and bounded automatic-task settle are after timing.
Retain every preconditioning run, scored sample, failure and pair in original order.
Finish all 3 rounds regardless of observed speed unless a functional/account/safety failure requires an abort.
No retry, dropped sample, selective rerun, extra round or optional stopping for the same candidate.
If a candidate fails performance gates, change actual source code and freeze a new candidate before repeating a complete 3-round suite; preserve failed candidate results.
Android15 force-stop restoration may deliver BOOT_COMPLETED; this is app-process-cold/app-cache-empty after stopped state, not ordinary OS reclaim or full-device-cold startup.
No recording, publication or claimed stable speedup unless every predeclared gate passes.
